PARAG.TXT: This Regulation lays down harmonised rules concerning the placing on the market and putting into service of artificial intelligence systems.
This Regulation applies to providers placing on the market or putting into service AI systems in the Union.
This Regulation applies to AI systems placed on the market in the Union.
For the purposes of this Regulation an AI system means a machine-based system.
Providers and deployers of AI systems shall take measures to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy.
The following AI practices shall be prohibited: the placing on the market of an AI system that deploys subliminal techniques.
